command:
set -eu
pip install --no-cache-dir 'huggingface_hub==0.35.3'
python -u - <<'PYTHON'
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
from pathlib import Path
revision = '72e1d3230f6c080a530b0a1d46f8eb4602340597'
snapshot_download('deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813', revision=revision, local_dir='/model', max_workers=8)
Path('/model/DEPLOYED_REVISION').write_text(revision + '\n')
print('DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE', flush=True)
PYTHON
containers.name: download
